entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I need to return something. My order number is VF88602. I'm looking at it right now. Just process the return.

Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. Let me just pull up order VF88602. I see it's for the Aero-Dynamic Helmet. To get started, can I ask what specifically is the issue with the item? Is it a technical fault or a preference?

A preference? What kind of ridiculous question is that? The color is completely wrong, it looks nothing like the website! I don't want it. The box is unopened, it's brand new. This should be simple. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
My apologies, sir, I just need to follow the standard process. I'm not trying to make it difficult. I see here the order was delivered 13 days ago, on January 15th.

I don't care if it was delivered 13 days or 13 minutes ago! I'm telling you, I want to return this helmet. If this isn't sorted in the next two minutes, I'm leaving a one-star review on every website I can find. It's that simple.

I understand your frustration, and there's no need for that. Let's get this sorted for you right now. The helmet is a standard item, and it's well within our 90-day return policy. Of course, we can process a full refund for you. It's crucial that you're happy with your gear, especially when it comes to safety.
Okay, fine. That's what I wanted to hear. So what's next?

I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a pre-paid return label to the email address on file now. You should see it within the next 5 minutes. Just print it out, attach it to the shipping box, and drop it off at any post office. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed within 3-5 business days.
Got the email. Alright. Thank you.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
